description:
The desktop music player from the future!


Tauon 14. Improved edition.
New album header and disc subtitle support
Screenshot From 2026-11-19 10-07-38
Shown are 2 new settings you can enable in the tracklist layout options full header and hide artist, plus the new disc subtitle.
> For subtitles to work on existing installation, run a tag rescan.
Improved Jellyfin/Navidrome/Subsonic performance
The update makes improvements to how remote libraries like Subsonic and Jellyfin work.
- Added network source picker to make it easy to pick remote libraries and playlists.
- Added playlist auto refresh and sync. Changes you make to playlists will now be sent to the server.
- Improved network buffering performance for faster seeking and transitioning. 🔥
Ratings write overhaul ⭐⭐⭐
There are now 2 explicit settings for reading and writing ratings to files. You can find these in settings under settings > library > ratings.
> ⚠️ Read ratings on tag scan will default to ON. Turn this setting off before your next tag scan if you don't want that.
Other changes
- Unified track menu. Many options are no longer hidden or in different menus.
- The track list can now be set to current album only mode.
- Layouts are now stored individually in the new layout folder so you can share them.
- Multiple language sidecar lyrics are now supported e.g. song.en.lrc.
- Added ban track feature with avoid ban settings.
- Added tempo control (experimental).
- Many bug fixes.
